# Orbivida

> Source-checked biographies of online creators, film and TV actors, musicians and athletes, in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German and French. Every factual claim on a page links to its source.

## Sections

- [English biographies](https://orbivida.com/en/)
- [Biografías en español](https://orbivida.com/es/)
- [Biografias em português](https://orbivida.com/pt/)
- [Biografien auf Deutsch](https://orbivida.com/de/)
- [Biographies en français](https://orbivida.com/fr/)
